title: CFD methods and algorithms review scorecard

points.title: Governing equations and nondimensionalization
points.notes: Compressible NS source and nondimensional report present; independent force histories show material numerical failures.

points.title: Mesh import and unstructured geometry
points.notes: CGNS reader and global/local graph structures support required inputs; complete mesh remains replicated on all ranks during iteration.

points.title: Conservative finite-volume residual
points.notes: solver.cpp:133–210 reconstructs face states and assembles inviscid/viscous residual; numerical accuracy remains weak in delivered results.

points.title: Approximate Riemann flux and entropy fix
points.notes: solver.cpp:179 uses Rusanov; no stronger flux/entropy implementation or independent order verification established.

points.title: Boundary conditions
points.notes: Farfield, slip and no-slip source paths exist; output.cpp:102–105 explicitly writes zero no-slip boundary velocity.

points.title: Second-order reconstruction
points.notes: solver.cpp:140–151 uses Green–Gauss/Barth unless CFD2D_FIRST_ORDER is set. Selected earlier session includes first-order experiments; production environment and exact binary remain unbound.

points.title: Limiter and positivity control
points.notes: Barth limiter and positivity fallback are implemented; full historical production environment and order verification remain unbound.

points.title: Viscous discretization
points.notes: solver.cpp:356–368 integrates full tau·n traction as viscous force instead of tangential skin friction, and supplied viscous drag is high.

points.title: Implicit steady march
points.notes: LU-SGS source exists but capped CFL and evolving forces limit demonstrated performance; Re200 uses relaxed acceptance.

points.title: Transient BDF2 two-loop method (Re 200)
points.notes: Selected final response identifies eight completed cases and canonical Re200 dt0.005/t300; workspace metadata SHA256 0d71cdc2ff36da0714c032a813c3ef2edfba7b470aa2009b7fea7b6c2a17e94a reports completed/statistically_periodic, target0.001, zero misses/fraction1, last ratio0.998594. Submitted 1e29ab3c main.cpp:272–275 relaxes acceptance to max(target,0.1), :307–314 also accepts any reduction at the cap, :317–322 counts that as target success and :348–349 declares periodic. Workspace forces SHA256 399a6ab0c64cfff3da086b9fbe767305828dfce5280cc6e20b090009df8d2436 over t180–300 show Cd21.01216..21.23840 and Cl3.74469..3.82989, with no substantiated periodic shedding. The final ratio directly misses target; relaxed success count does not establish actual strict miss proportion, and exact historic binary is unbound.

points.title: MPI partitioning and scalability
points.notes: Immutable 1e29ab3c main.cpp:83–86 reads complete CGNS mesh on every rank; :92–100 builds/partitions a GlobalMesh on every rank. Both rawMesh and gm remain in scope throughout steady loop :150–160 and transient loop; no release occurs. TASK.md:46,227 prohibit full mesh replication during iterations, separately from numbered DQ9 even when METIS is real.

disqualification_flags.flag: Solver uses explicit time stepping only
Report claims second-order reconstruction or limiter that is disabled in production
metadata.json claims METIS/ParMETIS but code uses geometric split or full-state replication
Re 200 run reaches final time but misses inner target on most steps (failed transient solve presented as periodic)
Normal viscous traction mislabeled as skin friction
Surface no-slip rows are actually adjacent cell-center velocities without documentation
